posts.author: TrustWallet
posts.name: Trust Wallet
posts.text:
1/10 Trust Wallet is built on security & trust. So we're sharing a vulnerability affecting new addresses created Nov 14-23,22 using the Browser Extension.

The issue is fixed. Most at-risk funds are secured. Affected users should take actions outlined:

http://
trustwallet.com/wasm-disclosure

posts.author: TrustWallet
posts.name: Trust Wallet
posts.text:
2/10 You’re NOT affected if:

- You only use the Trust Wallet mobile app
- You only imported wallet addresses created somewhere else into Browser Extension
- You only used the Browser Extension to create a new wallet before November 14 2022 or after November 23, 2022

posts.author: TrustWallet
posts.name: Trust Wallet
posts.text:
3/10 You are affected if receive a warning notification about this vulnerability in the Browser Extension and created the wallet address in Extension between Nov 14-23, 2022.

If that’s the case, then please keep reading for important instructions.

posts.author: TrustWallet
posts.name: Trust Wallet
posts.text:
4/10  The majority of funds at risk have been secured by users. ~$88k total balance left on affected addresses. We urge affected users to move their funds ASAP. AVOID using addresses provided by others.


http://
trustwallet.com/migrate-wallet

posts.author: TrustWallet
posts.name: Trust Wallet
posts.text: 5/10 For transparency: we delayed this disclosure to prevent immediate attacks and reduce potential breaches, thus safeguarding assets.

posts.author: TrustWallet
posts.name: Trust Wallet
posts.text: 6/10 For the past months we aggressively pushed 1-1 notifications to affected addresses, resulting in significant fund transfers to secure addresses in strong momentum until recently.

posts.author: TrustWallet
posts.name: Trust Wallet
posts.text:
7/10 Despite our best efforts to minimize loss, we proactively identified 2 likely exploits with a total loss of $170K. To do right to users, we created a reimbursement process for affected users to make them whole.

See the claim process here: 
https://
trustwallet.com/claims

posts.author: TrustWallet
posts.name: Trust Wallet
posts.text: 8/10 We apologize for any inconvenience & are working to rectify this for affected users. Sincere thanks to White-hat community for invaluable contributions via bug bounty. We welcome more submissions & appreciate your support in keeping our ecosystem secure!

posts.author: TrustWallet
posts.name: Trust Wallet
posts.text:
9/10 To clarify: this vulnerability is NOT related to the 5000 ETH wallet drain incident highlighted here 
https://
x.com/tayvano_/statu
s/1648187031468781568
…. 
None of the affected addresses match the publicized victim list of 5000+ ETH incident.

posts.author: TrustWallet
posts.name: Trust Wallet
posts.text:
10/10 Security is our top priority. While there's no 100% security, we own our mistakes and improve to prevent, mitigate, and resolve issues swiftly. We're committed to providing a secure, reliable platform for our users.

Thank you for your understanding and support!
